title: EventEnvelope
description: Envelope for every message delivered over the websocket /v1/events channel and every row written to the events outbox table (docs/PLAN.md §4.3, §6.3). The payload schema is selected by `type`. Additive-only evolution: see README.md in this directory.

id.description: UUIDv7, matches the events.id outbox row.

type.description: Closed enum today; additions are additive contract PRs (new event types are always backward compatible for existing consumers).

tsMs.description: Epoch milliseconds the event was written, server clock.

actorUserId.description: User whose action produced the event; null for system-originated events (e.g. scan.completed on an unattended schedule).

payload.description: Type-specific payload; validated against the matching <type>.schema.json in this directory.
